messages.subject: Error using an advanced sleeplog
parts:
Hi,
I'm writing because in our research we are having some problems. We are using an advanced sleeplog, which includes: hour woke up and went to bed and includes nap time with the same information. It is because we are working with people who haven't a regular timetable. When we analyze the sleeplog whit Ggir an error occurs and it don't bring us a result, despite the software doesn't notify any error. We wonder if the sleeplog is the problem or if we have to change some part of the code in the program.
In any case, thank you for reading and hope someone could help

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error using an advanced sleeplog
parts:
Hi Gonzalo,

First try to process your data with only mode=1:2 and do.report = 2.

Do this gives results and do you see more than two days of data? (we need at least 1 night) 

If yes, run GGIR with mode = 3:4, do.report = 4, loglocation = c().

If this provides sleep estimates from part 4 then try again but now specify the loglocation. 

Also make sure you read the vignette section on sleeplog carefully to make sure you have specified all the arguments for sleeplog correctly.

Best, Vincent
